# Environment variable names

Configuration keys should identify the application and the setting they control.
Use full words where practical so deployment manifests remain easy to scan.

## Preferred

```ts
import { Config } from "effect"

export const artifactBucket = Config.string("FORGE_ARTIFACT_BUCKET")
export const uploadConcurrency = Config.integer("FORGE_UPLOAD_CONCURRENCY")
```

## Avoid

```ts
import { Config } from "effect"

export const artifactBucket = Config.string("artifactBucket")
export const uploadConcurrency = Config.integer("UPLOAD_CONCURRENCY")
```
